reasoning: Plan A is the better training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster. It incorporates a dedicated tempo run, crucial for developing the sustainable speed needed for trail racing, alongside a longer, more challenging long run. Plan B, while including hill work, lacks a specific threshold workout and relies heavily on easy runs, which won't directly translate to improved speed. Plan A’s structured approach, with a focus on building both aerobic endurance and speed-specific strength, is more targeted towards the athlete's goal of becoming a faster trail runner.
